workflow.assistant: Defines the feature and visible evidence for each scene, then gives one manual capture step at a time.
workflow.user: Chooses characters, framing, visual mood and final attractive shots within the scene requirements.
workflow.capture_build: Use verified 2026-09-30-game-rc2; record exact manifest and UI scale. Focused smoke passed with recorded limits.
workflow.scope: Publication captures are not a repeat of the closed development test suite. A screenshot proves only what is visible in that shot.
workflow.language: English UI and English captions for all three publication pages and GitHub. Use a temporary test session and restore the preferred UI language afterwards.
workflow.presentation: Prefer a readable full-resolution screenshot with the relevant UI unobscured. Crop only for composition; do not invent game outcomes or alter displayed scores.
workflow.manual_steps: Request and complete one user action at a time. Do not launch or modify the active campaign merely to manufacture a shot.

scenes.purpose: Show the main promise: several negotiated terms on two sides of one readable deal.
visible_requirements: At least two meaningful terms that are actually supported in this session
scenes.framing_choice: The user chooses a compelling pair of rulers and terms; keep the main window readable.
scenes.caption_brief_en: Build a complete agreement and see it from your counterpart's side of the table.

scenes.purpose: Show that other rulers can initiate offers.
scenes.reference: The completed development smoke produced Jeyne Arryn's 165-gold courtier offer. That observation is a scene reference, not a requirement to replay the old test.
scenes.framing_choice: Use a naturally available incoming letter from the package capture session; the user chooses the strongest narrative image.
scenes.caption_brief_en: Other rulers take the initiative with offers of their own.

scenes.purpose: Support a marriage-diplomacy theme without claiming an unobserved title transfer or conquest.
visible_requirements: The real displayed terms and expected outcome
scenes.framing_choice: The user chooses an evocative dynasty or AGOT setting if desired. Confirm the current mechanic before staging the scene.
scenes.caption_brief_en: Bring dynastic politics to the negotiating table.

scenes.purpose: Show a normal candidate list with the added live MCA numbers integrated into the native row.
visible_requirements: Scores clear of the scrollbar and other row contents
scenes.framing_choice: The user chooses recognizable candidates and a clean view without a large tooltip covering the list.
scenes.caption_brief_en: Compare candidate potential directly in the marriage picker.

scenes.purpose: Make the score understandable through its real native component tooltip.
visible_requirements: Readable native breakdown with components adding to that total
scenes.framing_choice: Choose a candidate with a useful mix of components and position the tooltip so the score remains identifiable.
scenes.caption_brief_en: See the components behind the score: a comparison aid, not a chance of marriage acceptance.

scenes.purpose: Show the optional MCA score ordering and the control for returning to the default list.
visible_requirements: Candidate names and unobscured native rows
scenes.framing_choice: Use the same list as the overview when convenient; favor a clear score spread.
scenes.caption_brief_en: Sort by MCA score to compare the most promising candidates first.

scenes.purpose: Show the adapter's specific contribution in an AGOT marriage picker.
visible_requirements: Candidate identity and full MCA total
scenes.reference: Rhaenyra's recorded development result was 95 = dynasty 35 + inheritable qualities 30 + rider potential 30. Use a current naturally available qualifying candidate, not a manufactured score.
scenes.framing_choice: The user chooses the rider and composition. The screenshot must not suggest a guaranteed transfer of the dragon.
scenes.caption_brief_en: AGOT:MCA includes current-dragonrider potential in the candidate score.

scenes.purpose: Show the adapter naturally integrated with AGOT and MCA, with a distinct recognizable setting.
scenes.framing_choice: The user chooses the strongest recognizable houses and portrait composition; an uncluttered wide view complements the detailed tooltip shot.
scenes.caption_brief_en: The familiar MCA interface, with candidate potential tailored to AGOT.

completed_captures.observed_caption_facts: Lord Bernard naturally offers Fine Regalia for 124 gold; all three responses visible.
completed_captures.caption_en: Other rulers take the initiative with offers of their own.
